downloads.sessionOnly: Task history is saved and restored after restart. Downloads continue when you leave this page. Unfinished tasks become interrupted on exit and can be retried with a fresh source. Removing a task does not delete files.
downloads.unavailable: Download management is unavailable. Please try again later.
downloads.scanFailed: File saved, but the local music list could not be updated. Please rescan in Local Music.
downloads.actionFailed: The action did not complete. The task is still available; please try again later.
downloads.loadFailed: Could not read download history. Existing data has been preserved.
downloads.saveFailed: Could not save download history. It may not be available after restarting.
downloads.interrupted: This task was unfinished on exit. Retry to download it again.

phase.unknown: Status unconfirmed. Refresh the status before continuing.
phase.saved: The file may have been saved. Check the destination before downloading again.
